asr.full_text: What's up, it's Alisha. Today I'm going to show you my latest Ulta haul that I paid 73 cents for. It's a lot of stuff. Ulta has possibly the best rewards program out of any store that I have ever shopped at, ever. If you time your purchases right, you can end up getting a lot of points which converts into a lot of cash to spend on another purchase. They do platino appreciation day where you get up to 10 times the points. 10 times the points on certain products and then i think it's five times the points on everything else. I timed my purchases correctly. I did buy some stuff on the platinum appreciation day which was a couple of months ago, I think so I was able to accumulate about $300 in Ulta cash that I could spend on anything I wanted which is crazy! Oh my gosh! and so I ended up paying, I think, 73 cents for all this which is pretty awesome aw, get this giant box! Oh my gosh ULTA so the first thing that I got I was actually surprised that I got this pretty awesome. Ughhh!!! Get this giant box! Oh my gosh. Aarghhh!!! Ultalah! So the first thing that I got, I was actually surprised that I got this but it is the Jaclyn Hill palette from Morphe. I own very very little Morphe stuff. People are on two sides of the fence with the Morphe in the sense that some people really like it because it's inexpensive and other people do not like it because there is a very big thing with codes and discount codes and shillings so to speak. I got this because I heard it was really good and the colors are really really vibrant which I'm a fan of... I like Jaclyn Hill as well so I wanted to check it out! Really this corner is what drew me into it so I haven't played with it yet I think Ill do a tutorial or or get ready with me to video playdate style with this soon though because he wanna play with it but I like that it has it decent range in colors they're similarly colourful she line neutral the war tones but I did like that kinda combination of on not and shimmery colors in there I also took the opportunity because I did not know that the That Ulta sold Manic Panic And I always need Manic Panic for my hair as you can see it's quite red so I got two Containers of the pillar box red shade, I use that or rock and roll red I just did my roots last night, and I did rock and roll red I can see my scalp is stained. I use those on my roots mainly I really don't die the length of my hair because I use what I've been using lately, but it actually I just ran out of it is overtone which is a deep conditioner that Applies color as as conditions and so usually twice a month maybe I will just coat that my hair and leave it in for a couple of hours and then rinse it out then I also have used the viral shampoo which is a color depositing shampoo kind of straight away from it because I realized that it was making my hair quite oily or having a lot of product built up so I don't use that nearly as often but my hair i it's definitely kept the color for a long time. But what I did get is from JoICO, which I didn't know that they did we leave in conditioning treatments. Um, the colored treatments too, so this is called Color Butter from Joico and it is incredibly red as you can see. So I'm going to try this out next time that I need to brighten up my hair. Which is maybe in a couple of weeks. So if you guys want me to give you an update on this I can. I do like Overtone though, I think that one's really nice. I just don't love the way it smells, it has this pepper minty smell that I'm not about 100% But it works well. I also took this opportunity to get some things for Violet. Violet's hair is the bane of my existence. Now I am definitely, in no way, shape, or form, I am not a hair person at all. My hair has been short for the majority of my adult life, and this is the longest it has been in a very, very long time, and I don't know how to do hair, especially toddler hair. Toddler hair is a different breed of hair entirely. It's very thin, thine but just gets tangled and messy and crazy really quickly so Violette's hair has this beautiful curl to it, little cute toddler curls, but it needs the right product So the only way that the curls really show up is if when her hair is what if I stand there and kind of hold it for a couple of seconds and then let it go and then she doesn't lay on it or run around you know she's she's three that's just just what they do so i got some kid shampoo conditioner and cream to see if we can get this to actually stay i'll use um' shampoo on her hair. But then I use a little bit of my conditioner because her hair is just, it gets so tangled and it feels so dry that I feel like it needs just a bit of moisture to keep those curls and to keep it from just turning into a lion's mane. So I got a couple of different ones. So the fairy tale shampoo is the one that I got. It's very cute packaging. Let me smell it Smells Actually really good Has like an apple smell the majority of the kids stuff that I find at the grocery store and such It's like shampoo conditioner body wash all in one and I'm like no. I don't I don't want that Who I don't like the way that this smells though this. This one is from SoCozy, and it's the Curl Conditioner. Oof, it smells... It smells like Play-Doh! Which is one of the worst in my- Oh, yeah, so there's no nasties. That's why it smells like Play-Doh. Barf! Oh, well. Okay, and then I got the curl cream from the same company. Let's see if it smells like Play-Doh, too. If it does thats gonna Suck why would you want your head to smell like play doh yup well well we'll see how they work and then i'm gonna have to use some good smelling stuff because that noop.. that smells terrible this was also the order that i purchased my este lauder Double Wear foundation on which you may have seen the review and then the follow-up review I guess the first one really wasn't review it was the first impression and yeah so thinking I'm going to return that because it's really not my jam at all even when I retried it it wasn't as bad but I just don't see myself regularly using it so that was pretty much my whole haul. I really wanted to focus on getting Violette some stuff. I'm hoping that the curl stuff that I got her actually works well. We'll see uh because I just love her hair when it's all cute and like done but I don't know and I feel like It'll look that way for like half of a day, and then she will toddler it and just Because that's just the way it seems to go Let me know if you've ever bought anything with your ulta points because this is the first time that I ever used them I think I still I definitely still have some but I wanted to use them When the 20% off sale was a couple of weeks ago, just because I feel like that was the best time to do it. because, you can stack your rewards cash with the 20% off! it's like... amazing! so that's all for this haul! I hope you enjoy! make sure that subscribe button, that like button. leave me a comment and I'll be reading them I can be reading them. I will be reading them all and I'll see you next time.
